facts.fact: StackAdapt states that its Audience Insights analysis compares data from hundreds of millions of users to identify what is unique about an advertiser's audience.
facts.quote: This analysis is based on comparing data of hundreds of millions of users to extract what is unique about your audience

facts.fact: StackAdapt's blog gives an example in which Audience Insights found that users interested in travel blogs also showed interest in luxury travel, national parks, and travel within the United States.
facts.quote: Audience Insights revealed that users interested in travel blogs exhibited additional interests in luxury travel, national parks, and travel within the United States.

facts.fact: The StackAdapt blog post 'Leveraging audience insights to improve brand storytelling' was published on July 29, 2020.
